answer.renewal: The Authority may extend it twice, by 12 months each time, with at least three months' written notice.
answer.notice: The Authority may end it at any time with at least six months' written notice; either party may end it at once for material breach.
answer.fees: £456,500 a year (maintenance £148,000, cleaning £96,500, security £212,000), paid monthly in arrears within 30 days and adjusted each year by RPI.
